title: driver-sql: MySQL leg of the file-family column migration (`JSON_UNQUOTE` + `MODIFY`, abort-on-non-string, arm flip in the same act) — deferred from #15989 until a MySQL is reachable
body:
Split from #15989 by the maintainer's ruling A (decision batch #120 item 1, 2026-09-12): PostgreSQL and SQLite complete the file-family column migration now with the measured-correct abort-on-non-string clause; **MySQL is deferred to this card** because no MySQL is reachable from the dev containers and the #15041 addendum leaves the MySQL statement ORDER unsettled.

Blocked-by: #15989

## What this card owns

The MySQL dialect of the `os migrate files-to-references --apply` column step for the file family (`file` / `image` / `avatar` / `video` / `audio`): the `JSON_UNQUOTE` + `MODIFY` sequence, in an order that (1) aborts on the first cell that is not a JSON string — the same guarantee the PostgreSQL / SQLite clauses give after #15989 — and (2) flips the driver arm (`fileColumnsMoved`, keyed on `sys_migration.columns_moved_at`) in the SAME act as the column move, never as a follow-up. Pins for both encodings across the window, on a real MySQL.

## ⛔ Restart-when

Restart-when: a MySQL 8.x instance is reachable from the dispatch environment (a seat records the connection reading on this card), or the maintainer names one.

## ⚠️ Carried unknown

No seat has any MySQL reading. If MySQL needs a different column-migration SHAPE (not merely an order), this card widens into a design split rather than one dialect leg — say so before building.

## Refs

#15989 (ruling A, 2026-09-12) · #15041 (`5551135629`) · #15771 · ADR-0104
